verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents an Answers endpoint built to research a question on the live web and return JSON with source URLs, which gives structured, citable output. Its schema-shaped extraction also offers grounding controls. However, no named preset or configuration profile tuned for research agents is documented; the capability exists only as a dedicated endpoint. Missing for 10: an explicit research-agent preset/configuration, detail on citation format and depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can apply a preset configuration tuned for research agents that returns structured, citable output

citations.quote: Research a question or task on the live web and return JSON with source URLs.
Crawl relevant pages and return an object that matches your JSON Schema, with controls for grounding, coverage, and freshness.
